review.note: Release 0.3.2 corrects explicit relative --source paths to use the invoking working directory, independently of the repository installation/callback directory. Source identity is resolved before environment replacement; missing caller artifacts fail without borrowing a repository-local same-name file. No dependency constraints or snapshot schema changed. Four real uv installation counterexamples failed against 0.3.1 (repository decoy installed or missing caller accepted); all four now pass, including installed module bytes, distribution version, direct_url origin, callback cwd and preservation of the old environment on rejection. Complete environment/bootstrap/shell-entry selection: 52 passed. Ruff, formatting, strict mypy and Markdown passed through normal commit hooks. Native Windows is not claimed by local testing; the existing Windows layout regression remains included. Fresh artifact resolution, online code review and the canonical full gate remain separate required evidence. Registry discovery is checked against the previously reviewed 0.3.1 direct dependency releases: hatchling 1.32.4, packaging 26.3, build 1.6.1, mypy 2.4.0, pytest 9.1.1, pytest-xdist 3.8.0, Ruff 0.17.0 and markdownlint-cli2 0.23.3. Those exact versions are the local validation environment. Previously reviewed primary release notes remain applicable: https://hatch.pypa.io/dev/history/hatchling/ https://packaging.pypa.io/en/stable/changelog.html https://build.pypa.io/en/stable/changelog.html https://mypy.readthedocs.io/en/stable/changelog.html https://docs.pytest.org/en/stable/changelog.html https://pytest-xdist.readthedocs.io/en/stable/changelog.html https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff/releases/tag/0.17.0 https://github.com/DavidAnson/markdownlint-cli2/blob/v0.23.3/CHANGELOG.md . No new pin, relaxed bound or compatibility exception is introduced.
